Other Information:
1.    Only selected customers will be eligible for the above offers. The customer list has been prepared in line with the information defined by the Bangladesh Telecommunication Regulatory Commission (BTRC).
2.    To check whether a customer is eligible for the inactive SIM offer, dial *155* desired mobile number and then # from any Teletalk number. Customers can also verify the eligibility through the website.
3.    During the campaign period, customers can enjoy each of the two offers only once.
4.    To avail the offer, the customer must dial the respective USSD code.
5.    Unused voice minutes and data will not be carried forward after the expiry date.
6.    The offer will remain valid until further notice.
7.    The offer price includes supplementary duty, VAT, and surcharge.
